Package index

Recommended user API

Stable entry points for new analyses.

top_fit()
Fit a TOP model with validated inputs and named results
top_fit_custom()
Fit a TOP model with a custom second-stage design
top_score_support()
Prepare reusable null-model support for TOP score scans
top_score_scan()
Scan variants with a TOP fixed-effect score test
top_followup()
Fit detailed TOP models for selected follow-up variants
top_meta()
Combine TOP score statistics across studies

Backward-compatible and low-level API

Legacy functions retained for existing analyses and advanced workflows.
